verdict.rationale: The Department publishes a remote sign-in path for eFile and Pay that uses a User ID and Password, with a self-service forgotten-credential flow and a web login shell for the Business Tax Application. Nothing in the pack points to biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN, but nothing documents MFA either, or how credentials are first issued. Missing for 10: documented multi-factor authentication, evidence that initial credential issuance avoids mailed PINs or in-person steps, and hands-on corroboration of the full remote sign-in flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail

citations.quote: Log in to the eFile and Pay system below using your User ID and Password to view your reemployment tax rate.
This publication provides information on how to log into the new system, retrieve a forgotten user ID and password, and available resources.
serves an interactive login/entry shell, with registration and reemployment-tax transactions behind an authenticated session
